feature: unlimited rolling enrollment with bounded reservoir and review-then-commit

tests.name: session_start_progress_finish_lifecycle
tests.asserts: start->progress->finish transitions through Created->Capturing->Finished; first template is anchor

tests.name: start_twice_rejected
tests.asserts: calling start() twice returns an error

tests.name: progress_before_start_rejected
tests.asserts: progress() before start() returns an error

tests.name: finish_before_start_rejected
tests.asserts: finish() before start() returns an error

tests.name: finish_with_too_few_candidates_cancels
tests.asserts: finish() with <3 candidates cancels the session and returns an error

tests.name: bounded_reservoir_stays_within_limit_with_25k_frames
tests.asserts: reservoir never exceeds max (100) across 25000 frames; exactly 100 admitted, replacements occur

tests.name: diverse_gallery_not_just_top_score
tests.asserts: diversity-aware selector includes >=3 orthogonal embedding directions, not just top-score collinear ones

tests.name: cancel_writes_nothing_to_store
tests.asserts: cancel via review_then_commit writes no sealed file and leaves store empty

tests.name: cancel_direct_writes_nothing
tests.asserts: cancel() directly writes no sealed file and clears the reservoir

tests.name: finish_stores_templates_only_no_raw_frames
tests.asserts: stored profile contains embedding vectors only; no raw frame bytes are persisted

tests.name: metrics_labelled_correctly_not_far_frr
tests.asserts: EnrollmentQuality and MatchConfidence labels do not contain FAR or FRR

tests.name: match_confidence_high_for_identical_gallery
tests.asserts: identical held-out and gallery embeddings produce mean_similarity=1.0 and score=100

tests.name: match_confidence_zero_for_orthogonal_gallery
tests.asserts: orthogonal held-out vs gallery produces mean_similarity=0 and score=0

tests.name: merge_appends_to_existing_gallery
tests.asserts: Merge decision appends new templates to existing gallery; first entry stays anchor

tests.name: replace_overwrites_existing_gallery
tests.asserts: Replace decision discards existing gallery and keeps only new templates

tests.name: reservoir_replaces_lowest_quality_when_full
tests.asserts: full reservoir evicts lowest-score entry on admission of higher-score candidate; rejects below-floor candidates

tests.name: drop_zeroizes_raw_frames
tests.asserts: cancel() clears the reservoir, triggering zeroize on raw frames
